children: Qualcomm Technologies, has unveiled its newest premium mobile lineup – the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 Mobile Platform and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Mobile Platform.
Designed to meet the evolving needs of consumers and OEM partners, both platforms power a new generation of mobile experiences.

"Today marks a milestone as we introduce not one, but two new flagship mobile platforms, delivering agentic AI experiences that are immediate, personal, and adaptive," said Chris Patrick, Senior Vice President and General Manager of Mobile Handsets, Qualcomm.

"As the agentic AI age evolves, our multi-flagship strategy allows us to push the boundaries of what's possible for mobile while bringing our latest AI innovations to a broader range of premium devices. By designing two innovative platforms, we're giving OEMs greater choice as we collectively shape the capabilities of the next generation of intelligent, personalized, mobile experiences.”

As Qualcomm Technologies’ most powerful mobile platform, Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 delivers breakthrough AI capabilities and advanced performance to power the most advanced Android smartphones.
* Enables everyday agents to deliver faster, more personalised, and more dependable experiences that adapt to users throughout the day.
* Enhanced mobile gaming with the new Adreno Neural Fusion, using AI to deliver intelligent graphics for more immersive gameplay, richer visuals, and longer playtime.

* AI powered camera capabilities with Advanced Professional Video (APV) support and Intelligent Pixel Control deliver deeper scene understanding, enhanced image quality, and more natural-looking photos and videos.

Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 is built on the same advanced 2nm process node, powered by the custom-built Qualcomm Oryon CPU, rearchitected Qualcomm Adreno GPU, and the advanced Qualcomm Hexagon NPU. This enables the platform to power many of the same breakthrough AI, gaming, imaging, and connectivity features as Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 to a broader range of top-tier smartphones.
Devices powered by Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 will debut in flagship smartphones from leading global OEMs and smartphone brands, the company said.
